Published - November 13, 2026 07:48 am IST - Mount Maunganui (New Zealand)
FIle photo of captain Shreyas Iyer during a practice session.
India skipper Shreyas Iyer won the toss and elected to bowl against New Zealand in the fourth ODI of the five-match series in Mount Maunganui on Friday (November 13, 2026).
India are leading the series 2-0 after the third match was washed out.
As expected, India gave a look-in to Ruturaj Gaikwad, Kuldeep Yadav and Ishan Kishan.
Gaikwad will open with Rohit Sharma after regular captain Shubman Gill moved over for red-ball training ahead of the Test series.
Kishan came in place of K.L. Rahul, who also will be part of the training camps ahead of the two-match Test series.
India: Shreyas Iyer (captain), Rohit Sharma, Ruturaj Gaikwad, Virat Kohli, Ishan Kishan (vice-captain, wicketkeeper), Axar Patel, Naman Dhir, Auqib Nabi, Kuldeep Yadav, Gurnoor Brar, Arshdeep Singh.
New Zealand : Tim Seifert (wicketkeeper), Will Young, Nick Kelly, Dean Foxcroft, Finn Allen, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner (captain), Kristian Clarke, Kyle Jamieson, Matt Henry, Matthew Fisher.
